# qrcodegen (vendored)

- Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator
- Version: tag `v1.8.0`, commit `720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb`

never draws a QR code from anything other than this encoder's output.
